metadata.question: Was the water extent at the River Nene larger, specifically 5 km radius around (53.083908, -0.819876) on January 4,2024 than on January 5, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 GRD (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD), as radar is cloud-insensitive. Filter within a 5 km radius around the point (-0.819876, 53.083908). First try the exact day window [date, date+1 day). If empty, expand to ±3 days as a fallback. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud mask needed. Convert VV to dB and classify water via an adaptive threshold (10th percentile dB within ROI) to robustly capture low-backscatter water. 3. Logic for valid zero vs null: If image collections empty after fallback -> C1. If valid pixel count after processing is 0 -> C2. If any computed metric is null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise compare water area; larger on 2024-01-04 => A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lon = -0.819876; const lat = 53.083908; const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(5000); // 5 km radius const dateA = '2024-01-04'; const dateB = '2022-01-05'; // Helper: build S1 collection for a date with a window (±windowDays; 0 means [d, d+1)) function getS1Collection(dateStr, windowDays) { const d = ee.Date(dateStr); const start = windowDays === 0 ? d : d.advance(-windowDays, 'day'); const end = windowDays === 0 ? d.advance(1, 'day') : d.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day'); const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'ASCENDING').or(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'DESCENDING'))); return { col, start, end }; } async function prepareComposite(dateStr) { // Try exact day let attempt = getS1Collection(dateStr, 0); let size = await attempt.col.size().getInfo(); let usedWindow = 0; if (size === 0) { // Fallback ±3 days attempt = getS1Collection(dateStr, 3); size = await attempt.col.size().getInfo(); usedWindow = 3; } return { size, usedWindow, col: attempt.col, start: attempt.start, end: attempt.end }; } async function computeWaterStats(dateStr, label) { const prep = await prepareComposite(dateStr); if (prep.size === 0) { console.log(`${label} Images: 0`); return { status: 'C1' }; } // Composite (median) const comp = prep.col.median().clip(roi); // VV to dB with small floor const vv = comp.select('VV'); const vvDb = vv.max(1e-6).log10().multiply(10).rename('VVdB'); // Threshold: 10th percentile dB within ROI const pDict = await vvDb.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.percentile([10]), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).getInfo(); const thresh = pDict ? pDict['VVdB_p10'] : null; if (thresh === null || Number.isNaN(thresh)) { console.log(`${label} Threshold: NaN`); return { status: 'C3' }; } // Water mask const water = vvDb.lt(thresh); // Valid pixel count and water pixel count (at 1 km scale for robustness/speed) const validCount = await vvDb.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('VVdB').getInfo(); if (!validCount || validCount === 0) { console.log(`${label} Valid px: 0`); return { status: 'C2' }; } const waterPx = await water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('VVdB').getInfo(); // Area in km2 const waterAreaM2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(water).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('area').getInfo(); if (waterAreaM2 === null || Number.isNaN(waterAreaM2)) { console.log(`${label} Area: NaN`); return { status: 'C3' }; } const waterKm2 = waterAreaM2 / 1e6; console.log(`${label} Images: ${prep.size} (±${prep.usedWindow}d)`); console.log(`${label} Valid px: ${validCount}, Water px: ${waterPx || 0}`); console.log(`${label} Water km2: ${waterKm2.toFixed(3)}, Thr_dB: ${thresh.toFixed(2)}`); return { status: 'OK', waterKm2, meta: { size: prep.size, window: prep.usedWindow } }; } // 2. Run both dates const resA = await computeWaterStats(dateA, '2024-01-04'); if (resA.status !== 'OK') { console.log(resA.status); return; } const resB = await computeWaterStats(dateB, '2022-01-05'); if (resB.status !== 'OK') { console.log(resB.status); return; } // 3. Final comparison and answer const a = resA.waterKm2; const b = resB.waterKm2; if (a === null || b === null || Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Print concise summary console.log(`Compare (km2): 2024=${a.toFixed(3)} vs 2022=${b.toFixed(3)}`); if (a > b) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
